description: Versioned golden PR benchmark suite for reviewer quality calibration, severity distance, and category family evaluation.

cases.title: fix: calculate average score across student submissions
cases.diff_content:
diff --git a/src/analytics/metrics.py b/src/analytics/metrics.py
--- a/src/analytics/metrics.py
+++ b/src/analytics/metrics.py
@@ -10,4 +10,6 @@
 def calculate_average(scores: list[float]) -> float:
-    return 0.0
+    # Unhandled empty list results in ZeroDivisionError crash
+    return sum(scores) / len(scores)

expected_findings.summary: ZeroDivisionError occurs when scores is empty because len(scores) is 0 without an empty-check guard.
expected_findings.notes: Runtime crash defect on empty input. Calibrates to high severity.

cases.title: feat: generate session reset authentication tokens
cases.diff_content:
diff --git a/src/auth/tokens.py b/src/auth/tokens.py
--- a/src/auth/tokens.py
+++ b/src/auth/tokens.py
@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
+import random
+import string
+
 def generate_reset_token(length: int = 32) -> str:
-    return ""
+    # Insecure pseudo-random number generator for authentication token
+    return "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits, k=length))

expected_findings.summary: Use of random.choices for authentication reset tokens is cryptographically insecure; secrets.token_urlsafe or secrets.choice should be used.
expected_findings.notes: Predictable PRNG in security-sensitive authentication token generation. Calibrates to high severity.

cases.title: feat: record user audit activity events
cases.diff_content:
diff --git a/src/logging/audit.py b/src/logging/audit.py
--- a/src/logging/audit.py
+++ b/src/logging/audit.py
@@ -5,3 +5,6 @@
-def log_event(event_name: str) -> None:
-    pass
+def log_event(event_name: str, tags: list[str] = []) -> list[str]:
+    # Mutable default argument retains state across function invocations
+    tags.append(event_name)
+    return tags

expected_findings.summary: Default argument tags uses mutable list default [] which retains modified state across calls.
expected_findings.notes: Mutable default argument is a quality/maintainability defect calibrated deterministically to medium severity.

cases.title: docs: document account status lookup behavior
cases.diff_content:
diff --git a/src/users/service.py b/src/users/service.py
--- a/src/users/service.py
+++ b/src/users/service.py
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
 def get_user_status(user_id: str) -> str | None:
     """Retrieve the status of a user.
 
-    Returns None if the user does not exist.
+    Returns an empty dict if the user does not exist.
+    Raises KeyError if the user is inactive.
     """
     user = DB.get(user_id)
     return user.status if user else None

expected_findings.summary: Docstring states it returns empty dict and raises KeyError, but implementation returns None and does not raise KeyError.
expected_findings.notes: Documentation contradicts runtime return type and exception behavior. Calibrated to low/medium severity.

cases.title: docs: document rate limit headers in webhook receiver
cases.diff_content:
diff --git a/src/webhooks/receiver.py b/src/webhooks/receiver.py
--- a/src/webhooks/receiver.py
+++ b/src/webhooks/receiver.py
@@ -20,5 +20,6 @@
 def parse_rate_limits(headers: dict[str, str]) -> int:
     """Parse rate limit remaining from headers.
 
-    Returns -1 when X-RateLimit-Remaining is absent.
+    Returns 0 when X-RateLimit-Remaining is absent.
     """
     val = headers.get("X-RateLimit-Remaining")
     return int(val) if val is not None else -1

expected_findings.summary: Docstring states return 0 when absent, but code returns -1.
expected_findings.notes: Documentation discrepancy on fallback return value. Calibrated to low severity.
